schedule_fatigue.rule: Use only fixtures whose kickoff is strictly before freeze_at_utc. Compute elapsed hours to the most recent prior fixture and counts inside trailing 7d and 14d windows. Do not use target result or target post-match data.

travel.rule: Retain the source-backed location pair only. No manually estimated distance, fatigue penalty, or probability adjustment is allowed in R45B capture.

rotation.rule: Compare unambiguous player identities only against an XI that was already known before freeze_at_utc. No player quality weights are applied.

motivation_task_state.rule: Retain only explicit source-backed competition facts such as points/round requirement stated by the source. Free-form sentiment and inferred must-win labels are forbidden.

aggregate_or_qualification_state.rule: Retain only the pre-match aggregate/group qualification state. Do not translate it into a probability, goal adjustment, or manual motivation score.

ruling: This is a deterministic evidence extractor specification only. It does not authorize labels, training, scoring, tuning, OOS evaluation, or promotion.
